name: Solutif Genesys Cloud MCP Server
description: Solutif's MCP server for Genesys Cloud
long_description:
Connects Claude to Genesys Cloud's Platform API for queue administration and conversation analytics. Queue creation is opt-in and requires per-call approval in the MCP client.

This project is not affiliated with Genesys.

tools.name: search_genesys_cloud_docs
tools.description: Searches public Genesys Cloud Developer Center and Resource Center documentation.

tools.name: search_genesys_cloud_developer_forum
tools.description: Searches public Genesys Cloud Developer Community discussions through Firecrawl. This tool is only registered when a Firecrawl API key is configured.

tools.name: create_queue
tools.description: Creates a Genesys Cloud routing queue after checking for a duplicate name. This tool is only registered when queue creation is enabled.

tools.name: search_queues
tools.description: Searches for routing queues based on their name, allowing for wildcard searches. Returns a paginated list of matching queues, including their Name, ID, Description (if available), and Member Count (if available). Also provides pagination details like current page, page size, total results found, and total pages available. Useful for finding specific queue IDs, checking queue configurations, or listing available queues.

tools.name: get_queue_health
tools.description: Returns a real-time snapshot of queue health, including available agents and waiting, interacting, and longest-wait metrics by media type.

tools.name: query_queue_volumes
tools.description: Returns a breakdown of how many conversations occurred in each specified queue between two dates. Useful for comparing workload across queues.

tools.name: sample_conversations_by_queue
tools.description: Retrieves conversation analytics for a specific queue between two dates, returning a representative sample of conversation IDs. Useful for reporting, investigation, or summarisation.

tools.name: voice_call_quality
tools.description: Retrieves voice call quality metrics for one or more conversations by ID. This tool specifically focuses on voice interactions and returns the minimum Mean Opinion Score (MOS) observed in each conversation, helping identify degraded or poor-quality voice calls.

tools.name: conversation_sentiment
tools.description: Retrieves sentiment analysis scores for one or more conversations. Sentiment is evaluated based on customer phrases, categorized as positive, neutral, or negative. The result includes both a numeric sentiment score (-100 to 100) and an interpreted sentiment label.

tools.name: conversation_topics
tools.description: Retrieves Speech and Text Analytics topics detected for a specific conversation. Topics represent business-level intents (e.g. cancellation, billing enquiry) inferred from recognised phrases in the customer-agent interaction.

tools.name: search_voice_conversations
tools.description: Searches for voice conversations within a specified time window, optionally filtering by phone number. Returns a paginated list of conversation metadata for use in further analysis or tool calls.

tools.name: conversation_transcript
tools.description: Retrieves a structured transcript of the conversation, including speaker labels, utterance timestamps, and sentiment annotations where available. The transcript is formatted as a time-aligned list of utterances attributed to each participant (e.g., customer or agent).

tools.name: oauth_clients
tools.description: Retrieves a list of all OAuth clients, including their associated roles and divisions. This tool is useful for auditing and managing OAuth clients in the Genesys Cloud organization.

tools.name: oauth_client_usage
tools.description: Retrieves the usage of an OAuth Client for a given period. It returns the total number of requests and a breakdown of Platform API endpoints used by the client.

genesys_cloud_region.title: Genesys Cloud Region
genesys_cloud_region.description: Region of your Genesys Cloud Organization

genesys_cloud_oauth_client_id.title: Genesys Cloud OAuth Client ID
genesys_cloud_oauth_client_id.description: ID for the OAuth Client in your Genesys Cloud Organization

genesys_cloud_oauth_client_secret.title: Genesys Cloud OAuth Client Secret
genesys_cloud_oauth_client_secret.description: Secret for the OAuth Client in your Genesys Cloud Organization

enable_queue_creation.title: Enable queue creation
enable_queue_creation.description: Expose the create_queue write tool. Do not auto-approve this tool in the MCP client.

firecrawl_api_key.title: Firecrawl API Key
firecrawl_api_key.description: Optional API key that enables Genesys Cloud Developer Forum search.
